title: audit detail runner.operator_github_users
description: detail of audit rows with action runner.operator_github_users: the platform device's list of users outside the operator's organization who connect through the operator's GitHub account changed (ADR-076 section 7); counts only, never user IDs or the account. Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
